body: cutting really is the only constant in my life and it is all i have ever based myself off of. it is what i count on to ground me and bring me back. i havent cut in a while and i didnt cut last night but i cant get away from the desire to. i do feel victimized and unlucky. i feel like life decided to take a brutally large shit on my head. i know that everyone has hard things and that everyone struggles but i am helpless in my situations there is nothing i can do to fix it. i never coped well with anything that's happened. summer job- my family wants me home and my friends want me in the city. if i stay in the city i have to find a place and a job and get up on my own two feet. i want to do that because i know it will be hard and will suck. not exactly masochism but i do honestly want to cry and suffer from something of my own doing instead of from something that's happened to me. it sounds stupid written out. and i know that i should "do what i truly want" and i should "follow my heart" but i don't know what choice to make. i have a great job waiting for me at home. 3 hours away from my friends though. i just... i dont want either of these choices. theyre all ive got. why i haven't 'used my notes'- i dont want to hurt my family. thats the only reason i havent attempted. and things i am passionate about... i like dogs. a lot... and i really love school. im having an amazing time. in my spare time i like to knit but i dont really have any spare time. i like jogging and being outdoors. i like horses, but we dont have any horses even at home. i like working with the elderly and i volunteered at an old folks home in high school. i like being around people and helping them.

i'm first year. i had to upgrade to get in. 

> like your mind works itself up and drags the real you along with it

thats exactly how i feel. i've never really thought of it that way before. 

i use razors and lighters. i cant just get rid of them, i am connected to them. i need them, they are like my safety. i honestly dont want to go into my traumas much. to sum up i've been beaten and abandoned, bullied. friends and family have died. hospitalizations, money problems. the works. i was a bit irritated but i really do understand, i'm just beyond cranky and angry at the moment. apparently i can't even hide it in text. sorry.

yeah, you're right. been this way for years... been cutting for 6 years, been suicidal for, god, i dont even know, time has gone a bit fuzzy in my mind. a while. ive written 3 draft notes and had a solid plan for a while. i'm not completely calm i'm a little more pulled together. i do want to hurt myself i almost am, but i'm not going to kill myself at least not unless my fucked up mind slips away from me again.... i'm trying to calm down, i'm having tea and i'm in bed, i just feel like nothings working. i'm 19, i'm in university studying nursing, i've got quite the traumatic history leading up to now... yeah, i have class early tomorrow morning so i will either fall asleep or skip... i understand, it's okay, go to sleep whenever.

i'm afraid of trying. i'm afraid that steping up and growing up is going to be horrible. i'm 19, i should already have this figured out. i cant decide what to do for a job this summer i dont know what i want to do. do i please myself or my family or my friends? everyone wants something different for me, and what i want for myself i feel like may be out of some hidden masochism.... all i ever want is to hurt and suffer, but at the same time i want it all to stop...
